messages:
Marta: Quick follow-up from the policy bakeoff — we observed routing oscillation when tenant cost probes spike briefly. Thinking of a small change: deferred cost normalizer + split probe lanes (fast/slow). Anyone object? :thinking:
Ryan: Can you sketch the normalizer? Is this basically an EWMA with clamps or something else?
Marta: Yep, EWMA-ish but with three pieces: 1) clamp max delta per-update, 2) minimum time between effective updates (deferred window), 3) optionally bucket updates into a slow lane for low-sensitivity tenants. Super small config example:
```
cost_normalizer: 
  type: ewma
  alpha: 0.08  # learning rate
  max_delta: 0.12  # cap per update (fraction)
  deferred_window_ms: 800  # coalesce rapid spikes
probe_lanes:
  - name: fast
    weight: 0.6
    ttl_ms: 500
  - name: slow
    weight: 0.4
    ttl_ms: 5000
```
Sasha: Splitting lanes makes sense for latency-sensitive vs batch tenants, but watch out for bias: new regions/variants might get starved if all probes route to slow lane. Need a fairness guard or cold-start bump.
Amal: Agree with Sasha. My take: add a per-tenant max_learning_rate and a transient "cold_bump" that prevents immediate demotion of a region for the first N probes. Also expose probe lane in telemetry so we can inspect distribution.
Marta: Good call. Proposal update: default fairness_cap = 0.06 per-update, cold_bump = +0.15 for first 3 probes, and lane assignment uses tenant SLA + observed variance. Will add telemetry tags `probe_lane` and `normalizer_version`.
Ryan: Ops question: how do we roll this out without breaking old policy versions? We need a runtime compatibility flag so older routers ignore the new fields. Maybe `cost_normalizer=v1|v2` on policy metadata.
Marta: Plan: 1) implement normalizer behind gate `v2`, 2) run sim for 48h with synthetic spikes, 3) gradual canary on a handful of tenants, 4) full flip. I can draft the rollout checklist. :+1:
techops-bot: deploying simulation pod for cost-normalizer v2 (sim-2026-03-23-01) — logs: https://ci.internal/sim/12345
Sasha: Can you add a test in the policy-sim harness that injects asymmetric probe delays? That's what exposed the oscillation earlier.
Marta: Will do. I'll open a tiny RFC with config, sim results, and rollout steps later today. Thanks all. :rocket:
